subject.title: Add confirmation step to /new and /reset to prevent accidental session wipes

question: Should explicit typed `/new` and hard `/reset` require default confirmation, and should OpenClaw add any opt-out or step-count config for that behavior?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but changing explicit command semantics and adding config/default behavior is product-sensitive under the repository policy.

options.title: Confirm hard resets by default
options.body: Add a one-step confirmation for typed `/new` and hard `/reset`, keep `/reset soft` immediate, and defer config until user evidence proves an opt-out is needed.

options.title: Add configurable confirmation
options.body: Add confirmation plus a documented opt-out or step-count setting, accepting the extra schema, docs, and upgrade-policy burden.

options.title: Preserve explicit command behavior
options.body: Keep typed reset commands immediate and limit confirmation to visible UI affordances such as buttons.

recommendation.title: Confirm hard resets by default
recommendation.body: Add a one-step confirmation for typed `/new` and hard `/reset`, keep `/reset soft` immediate, and defer config until user evidence proves an opt-out is needed.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current and historical signal on the Control UI/TUI command paths and adjacent confirmation work.
